facts.fact_text: At 8 p.m. on 8 April 2002, around 30-35 persons gathered at Tünel Square holding candles, photos and banners.
The banners held by the demonstrators at Tünel Square on 8 April 2002 stated, inter alia, "All the world is Palestine, all of us are Palestinians".
The banners held by the demonstrators at Tünel Square on 8 April 2002 stated, inter alia, "an end to the occupation, freedom to Palestine".
The banners held by the demonstrators at Tünel Square on 8 April 2002 stated, inter alia, "Wanted Ariel Sharon war-criminal".
The demonstrators at Tünel Square on 8 April 2002 sat down on the street.
Two persons, including the applicant, continued to sit and shout slogans at Tünel Square on 8 April 2002 despite warnings from the police.

The applicant submitted in the application form that on 8 April 2002 he had arrived at Tünel Square in order to participate in the Human Rights Association's press release on Israel's invasion of Palestine.
The police chief warned the demonstrators many times to disperse on 8 April 2002 at Tünel Square.
The police opened a passage for the demonstrators to leave Tünel Square on 8 April 2002.
The group of demonstrators at Tünel Square on 8 April 2002 started to disperse.
Two persons, including the applicant, continued to sit and shout slogans at Tünel Square on 8 April 2002 despite warnings from the police.
The police used force to arrest the two persons, including the applicant, who continued to sit and shout slogans at Tünel Square on 8 April 2002.
The applicant and Ms M.A. were brought to the Beyoğlu police station following their arrest on 8 April 2002.
The applicant and Ms M.A. were released from the Beyoğlu police station 1.5 hours after their arrest on 8 April 2002.
The Beyoğlu public prosecutor considered in his decision of 7 August 2003 that the force used by the security forces was in line with Article 24 of the Assemblies and Marches Act (Law no. 2911).
A description of the relevant domestic law at the material time can be found in Mehmet Ümit Erdem v. Turkey, no. 42234/02, § 19, 17 July 2008.
